scope: Stage 1 structural ablation and reasoning-damage analysis (design.json): rebuild the anchor search's frozen mapping, materialize D, W and DW untrained, measure state KL/NLL and every unit of eval-set-1 in both modes at 40,960 tokens of context; T's evaluation reused. No recovery training, no full search, no Stage-6 work.

basis.ceiling: the cumulative ceiling over every attempt is the project cap's remainder rounded down; the cap is not raised
basis.per_session_hard_cap: $24 keeps the provider balance at about 8 days of the three volumes' storage after one session ($38.41 - $24 = $14.41 at $1.75/day); a second session needs a balance top-up
basis.card: L40S 48 GB (AGENTS.md P8.2; the search, the teacher evaluation and every student evaluation ran on it)

estimate.evaluation: measured anchor: the teacher's H-T eval-set-1 took 3.4 h and H-N 1.2 h on an L40S (a_teacher_20261030_012648). D is 28/36 of the teacher; W and DW are untrained and UNMEASURED: between about 0.5 h per mode (early degeneration stops) and tens of hours (generation to the 40,960-token context on most items). Expected first session $12-24; the full evaluation may not fit the ceiling, in which case finished units are kept and the remainder is a budget decision
